messages.subject: Re: Chicago R GSOC talk
messages.body_plain:
Thank you, Toby, for an excellent presentation yesterday!

Also, thanks to Brian Peterson, who spoke more generally about the program and making a good proposal.

The feedback has been very positive from prospective contributors. Specifically, they all seem to have a deeper understanding of what R-GSoC entails and what a good proposal is.
I encourage other mentors to forward Toby's slide deck or create your own short intro containing links and relevant information to prospective contributors.

Justin
